summary: End-to-end testing of MindShield's three new features: Admin Crisis Notification System, AI Auto-Flagging of Forum Posts, and Counselor Scheduling/Availability Management. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases passing including AI-driven CRISIS detection (chat + counselor-conversation), AI auto-flag of toxic forum posts, FLAGGED_POST notification creation, /admin/notifications CRUD (list, count, mark single, mark all), /admin/connect-to-counselor (idempotent already_exists handling), counselor profile + availability PUT. Frontend: notification bell renders in admin layout with unread badge, panel opens with CRISIS/FLAGGED items and proper labels, Connect-to-Counselor action dispatches API, Mark-all-read clears badge. AdminModeration shows 'AI Flag Reason' callouts on flagged posts. CounselorDashboard availability editor (input, Add slot, chip rendering, Save changes) works and persists via PUT /api/counselor/availability (verified server-side).

action_items: (Minor / not blocking new features) Counselor session does not survive a hard browser reload — useStore token isn't persisted to localStorage, so reloading /counselor/dashboard redirects to login. Consider persisting auth state (zustand persist middleware) for better UX. Same likely affects admin/patient sessions on reload.
(Optional polish) AdminNotificationBell silently swallows axios errors via empty catches — fine for poll loop but consider logging in dev mode.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /forum/posts deletes post_doc['_id'] AFTER returning the dict — but FastAPI/json serialization happens after the function returns, and ObjectId is non-serializable. Code currently deletes _id before return (line ~531). OK.
moderate_forum_content uses single-level regex for JSON which can fail for nested JSON; current Claude prompt asks for flat JSON so OK. Add try/except already present.
create_admin_notification stores user_pseudonym='Unknown' when not given for FLAGGED_POST — minor; could populate from author_pseudonym.
/admin/connect-to-counselor auto-pick uses total conversations as load (not 'active'); acceptable for MVP.
Counselor availability PUT does not validate slot string format — could allow garbage strings. Low priority.
AdminNotificationBell polls every 5s — fine, but consider visibility-based pause to save resources.
Frontend zustand store likely lacks persist() — causes session loss on reload (see action_items).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features (Crisis Notifications, AI Forum Auto-Flag, Counselor Availability) are fully working both at API and UI layer. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mindshield_features.py covers 19 cases including AI-dependent flows (uses small retries/sleeps for background moderation). One non-blocking UX issue noted: zustand auth state is not persisted across hard reload — leads to logout on F5. Counselor login UI has 2 buttons containing 'Sign In' text (the tab and the submit) — when scripting use exact text 'Sign In as Counselor'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Minor UX item: hard-reload logout is caused by Zustand store not using persist middleware; tokens live only in memory. Mitigation: wrap useStore with `persist` from zustand/middleware and key on localStorage.
